artworks.title: Bearded Man in a Velvet Cap with a Jewel Clasp
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man in profile with a full beard, mustache, and a serious expression. He wears a large hat with intricate patterns and a fur coat. The background is blank. In the upper left corner, there is a signature that reads "Rembrandt 1637."

artworks.title: Abraham Casting Out Hagar and Ishmael
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in an outdoor setting. At the center, an elderly man stands upright, facing slightly to the left, with a regal posture. He has a long beard, wearing a large headpiece and a long robe with rich details. A younger woman stands to his right, also dressed in flowing garments. In the foreground, a child in a patterned dress and cap walks towards the man, holding what appears to be a bow. A small dog is at the left, near steps leading to an entrance framed by an archway with climbing plants. The background features a stone courtyard with trees, sculptures, balustrades, and a partially visible building.

artworks.title: Abraham Caressing Isaac
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.8 x 9 cm (4 5/8 x 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing two people, an older man and a young child. The man is seated with his left arm around the child. He has a long beard and wears a hat, and long robes. The child's head rests against the man's chest, with curly hair and ornate clothing, holding an object. The background has etched foliage on the left and a textured area on the right. The name "Rembrandt" is inscribed in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Samuel Menasseh ben Israel
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a man from the chest up, facing the viewer. He has distinct facial features with a mustache and goatee, wearing a broad-brimmed hat that partially covers his short, curly hair. His clothing consists of a wide collar over a garment with vertical stripes or pleats. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain, emphasizing the man in the portrait.

artworks.title: The Strolling Musicians
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of four men and a dog. The men are dressed in elaborate garments, some with tall hats and cloaks. One man is holding a musical instrument resembling a bagpipe while another interacts with the dog in the foreground. The setting suggests an informal gathering, with the men standing closely together around a doorway where light is illuminating parts of the scene. The drawing is detailed and intricate, showing texture in the fabric and fur of the characters.

artworks.title: The Strolling Musicians
artworks.description: The image shows several figures standing near a window or opening. On the left, a tall person wearing a large hat and a fur-trimmed coat holds a stick. Next to them, another person plays a musical instrument, possibly a bagpipe. In front, a small dog is on a leash. On the right, two figures are visible. One holds a swaddled baby, while the other wears a hat with fur-like details. The background resembles a rustic room with textured walls and wooden beams.

artworks.title: The Pancake Woman
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a group of people. The central figure is an elderly person seated in profile. Their face shows signs of aging, with a prominent nose and deep-set eyes. The elderly person is wearing a long garment with a fur lining or collar. Surrounding them are other figures, including adults and children wearing hats or bonnets. The central figure holds utensils, potentially a knife and fork. Other figures in the background are standing or leaning, with various expressions. Details like a pot and plates are visible, suggesting a kitchen or dining setting. The linework in the etching is intricate and detailed.

artworks.title: The Quacksalver
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure in an intricate etching style. The person is standing with a slight forward lean, holding a basket in one hand and gesturing with the other. The face is detailed with a mustache and a beard, partially covered by a wide-brimmed hat that obscures the hair. The detailed clothing includes a puffed ruff collar, voluminous sleeves, and a long, flowy garment with ample folds and patterns. The person is also wearing loose-fitting pantaloons and shoes, with possible fur textures and bags or pouches hanging from the waist. The background is minimal, focusing attention solely on the individual. The lower part of the image is signed.

artworks.title: Curly-Headed Man with a Wry Mouth
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a person from the chest up, looking slightly to the right. The person has curly hair and distinctive facial features emphasized by shading. The individual is wearing a loose-fitting shirt with a collar and a cloak draped over the shoulders. The sketch does not reveal any jewelry or objects. The background of the etching is plain to emphasize the figure.

artworks.title: Bald Old Man with a Short Beard in Profile
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man, portrayed in profile from the shoulders up. He has detailed facial features with a prominent nose and a thoughtful expression. His hair is depicted as slightly unruly and balding, with a distinct fringe. He is wearing a robe or garment with a textured collar. The drawing style includes fine lines and textured, cross-hatched areas for shadow and depth. The background is plain and minimalist, emphasizing the focus on the character.

artworks.title: Bald Old Man with a Short Beard in Profile
artworks.description: The image is an ink drawing of a man in profile, focusing on his upper body. The man is facing to the right, with the right side of his face visible. His facial features include a prominent nose, furrowed brow, and a long beard. He has a receding hairline with curly hair. He is wearing a garment with heavy folds around his neck, suggesting a cloak or robe, depicted with intricate cross-hatching for texture. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain with some sketchy lines, and the edges of the image are slightly blurred, creating a vignette effect.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man in High Fur Cap
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person with distinct facial features. The person is shown in a three-quarter view, wearing a large textured hat that covers the head entirely. They are also wearing a coat with a high collar, and the background is plain with a lightly textured appearance.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a chaotic scene. The central figure is a man kneeling on the ground. He is wearing ornate clothing and his facial features are detailed. Surrounding him are several men, some wearing hats. One man is standing above him, holding a large stone aloft. The background shows a rocky terrain with some architectural elements visible on the right-hand side. There are no visible signs of jewelry or additional objects being held.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a group of figures. The central figure is holding a large stone over their head. Surrounding figures show various intense expressions and postures. The drawing is detailed with intricate lines and cross-hatching, creating texture. The background is rough-textured, complementing the foreground action.

artworks.title: The Tribute Money
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a historical architectural setting. The image depicts several robed figures gathered closely together, some wearing turbans, inside an interior space. The background features archways and intricate stonework. One central figure is slightly raised above the others and seems to be the focus of attention. The other figures appear engaged, with postures that indicate listening or conversing. The artwork uses strong contrasts of light and dark through crosshatching techniques to add depth and focus.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion: Small Plate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts an individual on a cross with a gathering of people clothed in robes surrounding the base. Some figures are standing with hands raised or clasped, while others are partially reclined. The background suggests an ancient cityscape with architectural elements. The detailed line work and shading add depth to the scene, capturing a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria Among Ruins
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene showing an encounter at a well. A figure sits on a stone ledge while another draws water from a well. The setting is structured, with stone arches and overgrown greenery. Additional figures are in the background, possibly observing. The composition features intricate details and delicate line work, indicative of careful etching techniques.

artworks.title: Christ at Emmaus: the Smaller Plate
artworks.description: Three men are seated around a table in the image. The man on the right has long hair and a beard, with a radiant halo effect above his head. He faces the man in the middle, who is bald with a long beard and is leaning forward with his chin resting on his hand. The man on the left has a beard and a tall hat, looking towards the central figure. They wear robes with flowing designs. A draped curtain serves as a backdrop, and a dog stands near the table at the bottom right. Fine lines detail the scene, with the signature "Rembrandt f. 1654" visible at the bottom.

artworks.title: Saskia with Pearls in Her Hair
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a woman shown from the waist up. She is positioned slightly turned to the side, with her head facing left in profile. Her facial features are softly rendered, with a delicate nose and prominent eyebrows, and she is gazing forward. Her hair is curly and voluminous, partially covered by a cap that appears to be adorned with small embellishments. She is wearing a garment with intricately detailed patterns, and her neckline is emphasized by a neckline adorned with lace or ruffled material. A pearl earring is visible. The background consists of a cross-hatched texture, with no distinct scenery depicted. The artist's signature, "Rembrandt," along with the year "1633," is faintly visible at the top.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait (?) with Plumed Cap and Lowered Sabre
artworks.description: The image displays an etched portrait of a person with a neutral facial expression, long curly hair, wearing a cap with a feather, a dark textured garment with a layered collar, and a decorative band around the neck. The background features an oval shape enclosing the individual with subtle shading radiating outward from the subject.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait with Raised Sabre
artworks.medium: etching with touches of drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.2 x 9.9 cm (4 13/16 x 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts the torso and head of a person in a seated or standing position, facing forward. The individual has curly hair, a full nose, slightly pursed lips, and a stoic expression. They wear an ornate cap and a textured garment with detailed patterns on the collar and shoulders. The person holds a large, curved sword with ornate details on the hilt in their right hand. The background is plain with visible etching marks. The name "Rembrandt" and the date "1654" appear in the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Joseph's Coat Brought to Jacob
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing four men gathered around a rustic setting. The focus is on the upper half of their bodies, emphasizing their gestures and expressions. The man on the left is slightly stooped forward, with long hair and a beard. He appears to be engaged in discussion. Another individual is seated in a large draped robe, with their head slightly turned away and long hair. A third man, standing, leans forward with curly hair and expressive hand gestures. The fourth man is seated on a lower step to the right, with a bald head, short beard, and holding something in his hands. They are wearing loose, flowing garments with heavy textures and folds. The scene is set near an aged wooden door, surrounded by lush foliage, creating depth in the backdrop. The piece is signed by the artist, Rembrandt, in a script at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Three Oriental Figures (Jacob and Laban?)
artworks.description: This is an image of three figures in detailed attire standing near an architectural structure. The figures are engaged in conversation, with one figure in the background observing. The setting includes an elaborate building with arches and columns. A small dog is included, and there is foliage around the structure.
